key_insight: CIDERS reformulates cloud-edge LLM collaboration as personalized bilevel optimization, using consensus-variate correction to balance global knowledge sharing with edge-specific adaptation.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical framework for deploying LLMs on cloud-edge systems where shared foundation knowledge and local task personalization must be optimized together.
method: Split the model into a learnable backbone and a messenger for efficient cloud-edge transfer.
Use personalized bilevel optimization: edge-side personalization at the upper level, cloud-side knowledge transfer at the lower level.
Inject global trajectory information into each local update via consensus-variate correction to align personalization with consensus.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong gains on compressed edge tasks, including 3.1× improvement in mathematical reasoning, 1.7× in code generation, and a 10% relative gain in instruction metrics.
watch_item: The approach adds algorithmic complexity and may require careful tuning to preserve the balance between personalization and global convergence in real deployments.
paper_title: CIDERS: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
